atoms.title: Freeze v3 content-free run identity
atoms.criterion: Before code implementation, v3 SHALL pin human-approved content-free evidence, repository baselines, protected paths, the 63-outcome synthetic evaluator, budgets, stop rule, and rollback artifacts.

atoms.title: Verify current architecture
atoms.criterion: Every decision-critical current-state claim SHALL be confirmed against current source or labeled unverified without copying private content.

atoms.title: Publish v3-reviewed architecture and change spec
atoms.criterion: The exact paired Markdown and HTML candidate SHALL conform to v3 governing evidence, pass all frozen synthetic requirements on paper, and receive fresh independent PASS results before tickets.

atoms.title: Reconcile independent plan reviews
atoms.criterion: Codex, Grok, MoA, council, CEO, engineering, design, and DevEx findings SHALL be fixed, cut, or explicitly parked without weakening gates.

atoms.title: Publish tracer-bullet tickets
atoms.criterion: Each ready ticket SHALL fit one fresh context, declare blockers, map to test IDs, and avoid later human-gated work.

atoms.title: Implement D1 subject, device, and consent
atoms.criterion: PWA sessions SHALL always bind to verified device actors. Under the default-off enforcement profile, durable scopes SHALL default deny from audited receipts.

atoms.title: Implement D1 persistence and operation receipts
atoms.criterion: Denied retention SHALL suppress transcript bodies under enforcement, the legacy TUI marker digest SHALL be encrypted, and PWA finalization operations SHALL be per-session, idempotent, leased, and synthetic-sink-only.

atoms.title: Implement M1-A request-flag hardening
atoms.criterion: A request flag SHALL NOT grant high-sensitivity recall snippets or a full-body read, with current approved Dr. Alex compatibility covered and no new clinical principal or root.

atoms.title: Review, verify, and commit bounded slices
atoms.criterion: Every accepted slice SHALL pass focused and full suites, protected checks, two-axis review, and fresh-context conformance before an atomic local commit.

atoms.title: Later physical isolation, user controls, and Hermes integration
atoms.criterion: These stages SHALL remain non-ready and unimplemented until a new human-approved governing contract defines process identity, encrypted root, deletion, backup, consent UI, and activation.
